source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Ensure you gather all initial details from the incident scene. Record the date, time, and location of the accident, including any relevant identifiers like the name of the department or section involved. Collect names, contact information, and roles of all involved parties, including witnesses. Document your immediate observations clearly and in chronological order.

3. Secure the accident scene.
Make it safe for others by isolating the area to prevent further injury. Take photos or videos of the scene before changes are made (if safe to do so) and collect any physical evidence, such as broken machinery or tools. Label everything meticulously, ensuring that you maintain an unbroken chain of custody.

4.
Gather witness statements.
Obtain statements from all witnesses and involved parties as soon as possible after the incident while memories are fresh. Encourage them to provide timelines, conditions leading to the accident, and a description of the incident from their perspective. Written statements are usually more reliable than verbal, so
